item.title: Classic Albums Live: Led Zeppelin IV at Miller Outdoor Theatre
item.description:
Friday, August 28, 2026 at 8 PM

Location: Miller Outdoor Theatre, 6000 Hermann Park Dr, Houston, TX, 77030, United States

Miller Outdoor Theatre welcomes Classic Albums Live back to the Hermann Park stage for a live concert recreating Led Zeppelin IV—an incredible album featuring some of Led Zeppelin’s most beloved and recognizable recordings—note for note and cut for cut under the stars. Audiences can sing along with favorites like as “Rock and Roll”, “When the Levee Breaks”, and of course, “Stairway to Heaven”. Considered one of the greatest albums of all time, Led Zeppelin IV is an album full of experimentation from the way it was recorded to the variety of arrangements. As the best-selling album of one of the best-selling bands, it sold 37 million+ copies worldwide. This performance was originally scheduled to showcase The Eagles’ Hotel California. item.title: Jill Scott in Concert at Smart Financial Centre
item.description:
Sunday, August 30, 2026 at 7:30 PM

Location: Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land, 18111 Lexington Blvd, Sugar Land, TX, 77479, United States

Smart Financial Centre welcomes Jill Scott and her To Whom This May Concern Tour, with special guest Akeem Ali, for 2 live concerts on the Sugar Land stage.
